_comment: Manually verified service terms missing from every automated source (openstates people files, docs.legis listings, legacy CSV). Each entry cites its basis. Never inferred.

ocd-person/82c2d686-98d3-4dc9-8655-4e610.basis: Jerry Petrowski represented AD 86 until winning the SD 29 special election of June 5, 2012 (vacancy from Pam Galloway's resignation); the legacy CSV records his whole 2011-2012 term as Senate only.

ocd-person/2a532097-b605-4d3e-90ce-d8ae3.basis: Jennifer Shilling represented AD 95 until winning the SD 32 recall election of August 9, 2011 (defeating Dan Kapanke); the legacy CSV records her whole 2011-2012 term as Senate only.
